header [42, 34, 189, 49]MEETING NOTES
text [42, 70, 307, 86]Date: September 27, 2026
text [41, 106, 775, 177]The research team reviewed the new document recognition system. Every result must include the original input and a clear transcript. We measure complete page latency, memory use, and character errors. Faster processing is useful only when the output remains accurate.
title [42, 195, 283, 210]Actions for next week:
text [42, 213, 465, 228]1. Check English and Chinese documents.
text [42, 230, 658, 246]2. Test tables, small print, and unusual page dimensions.
text [42, 248, 776, 264]3. Save failures and incomplete outputs with the successful results.
text [42, 266, 572, 282]4. Compare identical inputs on the same computer.
text [42, 302, 392, 318]Approved by: Research Operations
